title: Ocean Wave | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled within the renowned Mauna Lani Resort on the stunning Kohala Coast, offers the ultimate retreat for families and friends seeking a luxurious Hawaiian escape. This newly remodeled single-level home features three beautifully appointed bedrooms and an airy open-concept design that seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living. With expansive lanai pocket doors that disappear into the walls, the living room opens up to a covered outdoor space, complete with a grill and lounge area, perfect for savoring the tropical breezes and the melodies of Hawaiian birds. The professionally decorated interior boasts a large dining table for eight and an island for four, making it ideal for group gatherings. From celebrating special occasions to unwinding after a day in the sun, every detail has been curated to ensure relaxation and unforgettable memories. This home includes FREE Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort passes in 2026. The Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort was voted #1 resort in Hawaii by USA Today. Normally, resort passes cost $100/adult and $60/child but when staying at this home use for up to 6 people is COMPLIMENTARY with no additional cost each and every day of your stay. This includes use of resort pools, the river pool, waterslides, hot tub, a saltwater lagoon for snorkeling, lounge chairs, towels, and parking validation for one vehicle. It also includes a 10% discount on Spa Treatments, 10% discount on Lagoon toys and Cabana rentals. Guests love this resort pass, which gives them the best of both worlds with hotel privileges and a comfortable, well-equipped vacation home.
